title: Pericallosal, callosomarginal and ophthalmic source branches
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Explore the supplied distal arterial objects with their original neighboring anatomy models.

scenes.title: Left Pericallosal artery · source context
scenes.prompt: Compare the named source branches with each other and with the callosal and cingulate context. Follow their supplied course from several angles.
scenes.note: Original source object: Pericallosal artery.l. Source world XYZ and source-defined laterality are retained. The display shows an author-defined educational model with the supplied contributor attribution.
